senses.gloss:
Pijavana is the name of the father of sudās according to the nirukta. Probably this statement is based on a mere conjecture from the epithet paijavana used of sudās in a verse of the Rigveda, but may very well be correct.
Foot notes ii. 24.
vii. 18, 19. So aitareya brāhmaṇa, viii. 21.
